rows.objective: Provide a minimal readable diagnosis without command execution.
rows.adoption_rationale: It is the currently bound baseline design for the product workflow.
rows.limitation: Its output structure and evidence discipline are less explicit than later designs.

rows.objective: Require fact and knowledge citations while expressing missing information.
rows.adoption_rationale: It separates observed facts, supported inferences, and uncertainty.
rows.limitation: It is a design iteration and has no separate provider-run evidence yet.

rows.objective: Constrain output to the diagnosis schema and calibrate uncertainty.
rows.adoption_rationale: It makes evidence, command safety, and schema validation explicit.
rows.limitation: It is a design iteration and has no separate provider-run evidence yet.

rows.objective: Keep a structured diagnosis consistent across report, card, and recap outputs.
rows.adoption_rationale: It adds course presentation and multimodal consistency constraints.
rows.limitation: It is a recommended design, not a separately generated live comparison result.
